description: This Java class 'XmlSerializer' provides methods for serializing Java objects to XML and deserializing XML back into Java objects, supporting various data types including collections, maps, and custom objects. It is marked as deprecated, with a recommendation to use 'UtilXml.java' for marshalling/unmarshalling.

classes.name: XmlSerializer
classes.description: A deprecated Java class for serializing objects to XML and deserializing XML to objects, supporting various data types and collections, with caution advised due to potential database corruption when deserializing certain objects.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Java object into an XML string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a Java object from an XML string, with optional delegator context.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a Java object from a DOM Document, with delegator context.

methods.name: serializeSingle
methods.description: Serializes a single Java object to an XML Element.

methods.name: serializeCustom
methods.description: Serializes custom Serializable objects into XML.

methods.name: makeElement
methods.description: Creates an XML Element with a given name and value.

methods.name: deserializeSingle
methods.description: Deserializes a single XML Element into a Java object.

methods.name: deserializeCustom
methods.description: Deserializes custom objects from XML Elements.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe DateFormat for serializing/deserializing java.util.Date objects.
